settings.heading: Product features
settings.content:
Compact C-Shaped Design: Slides easily under sofas or beds for space-saving use as a snack, laptop, or reading table.

Integrated Magazine Pocket: Tan leather-like pouch holds magazines, books, remotes, or pens, with V-shaped rack for organized storage.

Smooth Mobility: Four caster wheels (two often lockable) allow effortless repositioning without floor scratches.

Multi-Tier Storage: Top shelf for drinks/books, lower shelf for magazines, and pocket for small items; load capacity up to 44 lbs on top.

Stylish Office/Waiting Area Fit: Pairs with brochures, plants, or decor for lobbies, as seen in hospitality settings.

settings.heading: Materials and care
settings.content:
Crafted from powder-coated metal frame for rust resistance, engineered wood top (often cherry or beech), and faux leather pocket for durability.

Daily Cleaning: Dust with a soft, lint-free microfiber cloth; wipe spills with slightly damp cloth and mild soap, then dry immediately.

Polishing: Apply wood-safe polish quarterly in circular motions for shine; avoid excess moisture to prevent warping.

Maintenance Tips: Keep away from direct sun/heat; lock wheels when stationary; no harsh chemicals or abrasives.
